title: The shared-tree guard has a recorded ruling on path-scoped git reset, checkout and restore
why:
A builder in lane guard-relative-write-escape ran `git reset -q HEAD hooks/test_guard.py` to unstage a file. No work was lost, but the rules forbid destructive git and no record says whether a path reset counts (lane report, 06:53 CST Nov 8).

[20:25 CST Nov 15, triage] Sighting (consultant 20:23 CST Nov 15, relayed by the coordinator; the consultant's word, unread by triage): a builder agent ran `git checkout -- .` in its own isolated worktree on #3562; the guard let it through; it reverted only its own uncommitted edit; nothing lost. Not a gap by the record: decision agent-worktree-discard-is-noted (origin/main docs/decisions, read by triage at 20:25 CST; lines 8-22 and 103-106) allows `git checkout -- .`, `git checkout -q -- .`, `git checkout HEAD -- .` and `git restore .` in an agent-owned worktree, logged as a note, and names two sightings of this form (second: lane findings-ride-in-lane, 2026-11-08). Not read by triage: whether the #3562 builder's worktree sat under .claude/worktrees (the decision's test) and the guard's note line for the call. No new step or draft: the outbox 'Settled, no step' line for lane fan-code-guard-2 (git reset --hard, git checkout --ours) is the same class. Status unchanged.
note: Done check: one record states whether `git reset [HEAD] -- <path>` (unstage only, no --hard, no --merge, no --keep) is allowed, and a guard test pins that verdict for both forms. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage. Second sighting (lane findings-ride-in-lane, coordinator 07:55 CST Nov 8): a sonnet builder in its own agent worktree ran `git checkout -q -- .` to drop its own uncommitted mutant edit in merge/merge.py; no guard refused or asked. Nothing was lost, but in a shared tree it drops other agents' uncommitted work (rule shared-trees-no-destructive-git). Unlike a path reset, which only unstages, a checkout or restore of the work tree discards edits. Done check adds: `git checkout -- <paths>`, `git checkout .` and `git restore` of the work tree are refused outside the agent's own tree (or always asked), per the record. Doing in lane bg-tail-loses-verdict ([ended:Lane:-bg-tail-loses-verdict]), branch guard-path-reset-ruling, Merge after #1998; a test-author pins today's verdicts first (07:50 CST Nov 8).
